intro: Howdy! My name is David. I'm a front end / UI developer and designer, and I run [Rainier Watch](https://rainierwatch.com), the e-commerce side of a Twitter account I started in 2013 to report when The Mountain was out.

I've built 20+ websites for clients and worked on revenue-generating products at agencies, for brands like Sony, the Ad Council, Laravel News, Microsoft, and SAP Concur. I love crafting intuitive digital things and user experiences that surprise and delight.
Being a child of the 80s, I'm embarrassingly obsessed with throwback design, which is how you ended up looking at a computer made of text.
